summary_en: This study tests decitabine plus cedazuridine (DEC-C) in adults with myelodysplastic syndromes who had an allogeneic stem cell transplant and still have detectable mutations, called measurable residual disease. DEC-C is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 3 or days 1 to 4 of a 28-day cycle, with up to 5 cycles before the Day 180 check and up to 6 more cycles if mutations remain. The study measures relapse rates and progression-free survival.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa decitabina más cedazuridina (DEC-C) en adultos con síndromes mielodisplásicos que recibieron un trasplante alogénico de células madre y que aún tienen mutaciones detectables, llamadas enfermedad residual medible. DEC-C se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 3 o los días 1 a 4 de un ciclo de 28 días, con hasta 5 ciclos antes de la evaluación del día 180 y hasta 6 ciclos adicionales si persisten las mutaciones. El estudio mide las tasas de recaída y la supervivencia libre de progresión.
who_for: Diagnosed with myelodysplastic syndromes and had an allogeneic stem cell transplant.
Gene panel testing before transplant found at least one mutation that the MyeloSeq-HD panel can detect.
Day 30 marrow test shows a pre-transplant mutation at 0.2% or higher (intervention arm).
Transplant day 42 to 100, 5% or fewer marrow blasts, adequate blood counts, and GVHD grade 2 or lower (intervention arm).
not_for: Past allergic reaction to compounds similar to DEC-C or other study agents.
Taking drugs metabolized by cytidine deaminase.
Active grade 3 or higher GVHD (intervention arm).
